design: Single Type0 Identity-H + CIDFontType2 synthetic rectangle glyphs, explicit CIDToGIDMap, per-code ToUnicode, 3 Tr, one TJ; original widths/adjustments and visible prefix preserved. Configurable UPM and metric enlargement, inverse font size and enlarged TJ adjustments.
conclusion: Baseline fails the original all-edge geometry gate; scale16 preserves cluster coincidence and non-top geometry within .002125pt, with top inflation explained by pinned PDFium source. Native implementation and acceptance remain required.

scale16_source_model.formula: rect top += trunc(rect top/64), after trunc(value*1000/upm+0.5) normalization to 1000 font units; no glyph modification

scale16_consistent_global_metrics.design: Single Type0 Identity-H + CIDFontType2 synthetic rectangle glyphs, explicit CIDToGIDMap, per-code ToUnicode, 3 Tr, one TJ; original widths/adjustments and visible prefix preserved. Configurable UPM and metric enlargement, inverse font size and enlarged TJ adjustments.

direction_format_probe.scope: Only Type3-to-wideCID conversion, original outlines and all scalar placements preserved. Repeated words require rightmost logical-start geometry, not merely copied-text equality.
direction_format_probe.conclusion: Changing Type3 to the proven scale16 wide CID representation does not repair mixed bidi or RTL word-order geometry. Preserve both guards.
